note: TESTNET ONLY. Per-chain settings of the EVM testnets, read by the EVM settlement adapter (src/adapters/evm-adapter.ts) and scripts/sync-evm-listings.ts. Public addresses only, no secrets, no RPC URLs. Addresses, deployment blocks and gas figures come from niara-contracts (README 'v1 deployments' and 'Network quirks', and broadcast/Demo.s.sol/<chain id>/run-latest.json) at commit ffbfa68. Nothing settles and the sync writes nothing on a chain until its 'reviewed' is true.
